# K-SUP/Ω — "ENVELOPE WATCHTOWER": the per-dimension join built as one machine

A single coherent architecture realizing, simultaneously, the guarantee profile of all 22 frozen ceilings. Every component names technology that exists today; where a rung's attainment is proof-completion or demonstration work rather than design entailment, the axis profile says so via evidence_kind. Region U_T; enters the tournament as a challenger, not a presumed winner.

## 0. TCB and substrate (AX-21, AX-14, AX-19)
- Trusted kernel written in a **pure, total-by-budget, integer/symbolic-only language** (no floats, no wall-clock, no RNG, no ambient IO in the type system — nondeterminism in the trusted path is a *build error*), compiled with the **CakeML verified-compilation substrate** (per the AX-21 ceiling's supreme-law rule-3 declaration, this removes the diverse-double-execution mitigation from the compiler link).
- Enumerated, hash-committed TCB: HOL-family proof-checker kernel, CakeML compiler theorem + runtime image, OS loader, hardware class. Every trusted derivation is a total function of its **committed input closure** (logical clock, seeds, canonical orderings, pinned toolchain identity all reified inside the closure).
- Effect mediation: **one seat** — effect-execution and trace-emission are the *same event inside the same all-or-nothing transition* (AX-19 rung-1 structural invariant), with the rung-2 whole-perimeter verification obligation carried in the AX-21 proof plan.

## 1. The serialization point (DIM-05/DIM-09; AX-03, AX-07, AX-08, AX-12) — the join's hardest seam, built honestly
One total, pure, decidable kernel admission predicate **K(state, transition, certificate)**, evaluated at ONE logical serialization point; every non-acceptance outcome — including an error inside the gate's own predicates — is a recorded, signed refusal with zero state change (fail-closed totality). Gapless seq' = seq+1 monotone history. Two admissible realizations of the *same* predicate, per the DIM-09 join attempt:
- **Mode A (default):** physical single-writer seat, single-commit-point atomic store (shadow-paging/atomic-rename), fsync-of-file-and-directory durability with read-back recompute-and-compare, PLUS an **external cosigning witness quorum** (Certificate-Transparency/trillian-class) countersigning every checkpoint head — lifting the equivocation cap from fork-consistency to split-view resistance (the AX-07/AX-08/AX-12 RESOURCE_BOUNDED clause, exercised, not waived).
- **Mode B (declared alternative):** BFT-replicated total order with machine-checked nonforking; admission at consensus commit. Its cost is DECLARED on the AX-17 ladder (consensus commit sits one latency/operational class below single-node fsync) — the K-TLOG/K-BFT join with the cost stated, never hidden.
- Both modes share: client-side nested k-of-n witness policies, countersigned pre-action receipts, static tiled read path (reads never touch the writer seat).
- Every commit is bracketed by **k-of-n external time authorities** (Roughtime-class malfeasance-provable timestamps + eIDAS-class TSAs) against pinned third-party keys — zero-producer-trust wall-clock brackets (AX-17 clause c).

## 2. Admission and grounding (DIM-02; AX-04)
- **Attested capture:** official-publisher signature verification where it exists; elsewhere DECO/TLSNotary-class TLS-oracle or TEE-attested fetcher binding bytes to the publisher's channel identity; elsewhere k-of-n independent contemporaneous capture witnesses. Anything below: typed UNKNOWN/provisional, never silently admitted.
- **Dual digest:** raw captured bytes + deterministic, third-party re-executable extraction E with committed byte-equality E(bytes)=t.
- **Enforced typed admission:** a source exists for the reasoner only through a typed, policy-checked admission act; all grounding is graph-constrained over the admitted set — corpus-size-independent by construction (H4). Grounding derivations are proof-carrying and offline re-verifiable against the frozen admitted corpus.

## 3. Reasoning core (DIM-01; AX-01, AX-05, AX-19) — per-cell partition join, one certificate format
Stratified dispatch over an explicitly committed, finite defeasible rulebase; **the explanation IS the proof object**:
- **Statute-shaped cell:** prioritized-default verified calculus (Catala-class defaults+exceptions) compiled into the defeasible base by a verified/validated compilation step.
- **General norm-conflict cell:** grounded (well-founded) labelling kernel with certified exhaustive defeater search; absence-of-defeater is itself certified or the answer is typed UNKNOWN.
- **Even-cycle escalation:** a P-time attack-graph cycle analysis detects queries grounded leaves undefined; those escalate to **ideal / sceptical-preferred certified acceptance** with a certified exhaustive-extension certificate (complete preferred-extension set or refutation-complete search trace; SAT/ASP-based enumeration, checker-verified) under a **declared AX-17 cost budget**; budget breach = fail-closed typed refusal, never a silent downgrade.
- **Decidable-theory atoms:** linear arithmetic, dates/deadlines discharged by a proof-producing solver whose certificates are re-checked by the kernel checker (grounded-defeasible-over-decidable-theories — the theory cell held, not ceded).
- **Case-law cell:** Horty-style precedential-constraint CBR with decidable forced-decision checks; the authority-state leg conditional on committed treatment data, typed UNKNOWN otherwise.
- **Citations (AX-05):** total, coverage-gated recognizer over a declared decidable citation grammar L(G); every in-L(G) string resolves to exactly one committed authority record with verified receipt (signature chain to pinned owner key, delegation at genTime, revocation, bitemporal validity at the citation's reference time); out-of-L(G) citation-like strings emit typed UNKNOWN-CITATION that never upgrades. Formal-object support-verification is decidable via derivation provenance (AX-01×AX-04 composition); NL-vs-NL support is excluded and typed UNKNOWN.

## 4. Time (DIM-04; AX-08)
Total bitemporal store: every fact carries (t_legal validity interval, t_knowledge transaction time); version-indexed retrieval; every answer certified consistent and replayable at a stated (t_legal, t_knowledge) pair under a declared formal amendment semantics; uncovered pairs return typed UNKNOWN.

## 5. Memory, lineage, audit (DIM-07, DIM-08; AX-06, AX-07, AX-13)
- Hash-chained certified episode log over **salted per-leaf commitments** H(salt‖body): verifiable-redaction/erasure certificates destroy a body or salt while chain verification and inclusion proofs survive — lawful erasure without silent deletion. **Declared composition rule with AX-13 (the seam closed at its seat):** any derivation consuming a later-erased input retains its commitment-level replayability (hash-chain verification) and is re-verdicted content-level as STABLE-over-erasure where an invariance certificate exists, else typed UNKNOWN-REDACTED — never a silent pass.
- Per-step recompute DAG: each transformation (input-hash, deterministic-transformation-id, output-hash) committed under a domain-separated Merkle root inside the signed release identity; verification by **either equally-maximal mode**: recompute-and-compare, or transparent STARK-class proof-of-recomputation (no trusted setup, same hash-assumption family).
- Every trusted output ships a certificate binding it to the complete derivation closure (source bytes, code identity, pinned toolchain, configuration, ordering schedule) — third-party offline zero-producer-trust replay.

## 6. Transactions, durability, liveness (DIM-10; AX-11, AX-15, AX-16)
- Controlled media: strict-serializable single-commit-point atomicity; recovered state is exactly σ_pre or σ_post; recovery Θ(uncommitted tail), checkpoint-capped, read-back-verified.
- Uncontrolled media (external calls): journaled intent/outcome with idempotency keys and compensations; the irrevocable external act structurally outside the atomic section; unknowable outcomes parked typed UNKNOWN (two-generals honored, never papered over).
- **Budgeted typed termination:** the kernel language has *no unbounded-wait primitive*; every task carries budget B(task); every terminal is one of SUCCESS+certificate / typed FAIL / typed UNKNOWN-REFUSED; stalls are typed, surfaced, certificate-carrying states with an accountable cause.

## 7. Verdict discipline (DIM-12; AX-09)
Four-class verdict object: {PASS+certificate; FAIL/CONTRADICTION+counter-certificate; **KNOWN-STABLE-over-UNKNOWNS** carrying a certified invariance proof that the verdict is identical under ALL completions of the unknown inputs; typed UNKNOWN with a machine-readable cause from a CLOSED committed enumeration}. Contradiction detection provably complete within a declared decidable class whose boundary is itself a committed machine-enforced artifact; coverage is a positively-proven census (a missing check is a detectable blocking state). Conformal-annotation tier and test-time proof search live strictly in the untrusted advisory band.

## 8. Untrusted producers (H1; DIM-11, DIM-16)
LLMs exist only as untrusted proposal generators: autoformalization candidates, plan sketches, lemma hints, parser proposals. Every proposal crosses into the trusted path solely as committed bytes through kernel checking: publisher-authoritative formal law preferred where it exists; elsewhere **n-version formalization admission + round-trip verbalization invariant + accountable human gate**. Dual informal/formal lemma handoff for proof proposals. No LLM output is ever a trusted decision (H1), and pinned-weight batch-invariant producers are determinizable per pinned class where deployed, entering the closure as replayable derivations.

## 9. Plans and orchestration (DIM-11; AX-02, AX-03)
Plans are pure derivations from the committed closure into typed dataflow DAGs; the decidable defect class (cycles, type-mismatched edges, unreachable goals, orphan stages, ambiguous order) is structurally inadmissible at derivation time; VAL-class validation and finite-domain synthesis with existence/nonexistence certificates. Execution is Calvin-class deterministic conflict-ordered tiers committing atomically at the serialization point; committed result bitwise equal to the canonical serial execution; tier failure restores pre-tier state exactly.

## 10. Cost and scale (AX-17, AX-18)
Deterministic abstract cost metering instrumented in the pure kernel: every run emits an **exact, offline-recomputable cost certificate** (operations, bytes hashed, bytes consed, stage invocations) — every quantile over a frozen workload is a theorem, not a sample; fail-closed budget gates. Throughput: deterministic parallel-map + ordered serial fold; **batched Merkle appends** amortize the serialization floor to per-batch; content-addressed memoization on unchanged inputs; saturation behavior typed and fail-closed. Bounds max(W/p, S, ⌈n/b⌉·c_batch) derived from committed corpus configuration.

## 11. Falsification and evolution (DIM-13, DIM-14; AX-10, AX-20)
Two-regime adequacy: (1) machine-checked refinement proofs exclude infinite defect classes on the verified perimeter; (2) for the remainder, a hash-committed finite mutation-operator/counter-design class M with the 100%-kill matrix an offline-recomputable release artifact; fresh-context adversarial critics (no implementer-rationale access) are blocking admission gates; every finding reaches a recorded terminal disposition; any survivor is typed UNKNOWN that blocks release and escalates to the accountable human as a certificate-carrying transition. Evolution: **floor-vector ratchet** — each step recomputes (never trusts) Floors(S_n) from the hash-chained census, proves pointwise non-regression AND re-checks preservation proofs for every committed spec'd class; the certified set only grows; failure refuses fail-closed.

## 12. Generality (DIM-15; AX-22)
Every trusted mechanism is one function parameterized by a hash-committed legal-order PROFILE (article ranges, publisher identity/keys, script normalization, calendar, citation grammar, deontic lexicon) with an information-flow **noninterference** obligation: no trusted decision depends on jurisdiction facts except through the profile. Profile-composition conflict-of-laws meta-rules are themselves profile data. Orders without a committed well-formed profile: typed UNKNOWN.

## Buildable-today inventory (no vaporware)
CakeML (verified, bootstrapped, offline-obtainable); Catala; grounded/ASPIC+-style labelling and SAT/ASP extension enumeration (clingo/μ-toksia-class, wrapped with kernel-checked certificates); proof-producing SMT (veriT/cvc5 proofs, checked); Roughtime + eIDAS TSAs; DECO/TLSNotary, TEE attestation; CT/trillian witness cosigning; STARK toolchains; Calvin deterministic execution; ARIES/FSCQ-class verified recovery precedent; conformal prediction (advisory tier). Each seat is one committed mechanism — no wrappers, no duplicate seats.

exceed_claims.claim: CEILING-FALSIFICATION ATTEMPT (cross-axis composition the per-axis freeze cannot see): AX-01's closing exclusion — 'nor resolve genuinely contested interpretation' — is true as stated but overstates the induced UNKNOWN region. Compose it with AX-09's certified-invariance branch: for a query whose source span is interpretively contested, commit the finite candidate-reading set as typed alternatives, evaluate the verdict under ALL committed readings, and where the verdict is identical emit KNOWN-STABLE-over-CONTESTED-READINGS with a certified invariance proof. The contest is never resolved (the exclusion stands letter-perfect), yet the system emits a certified KNOWN legal conclusion on a query the AX-01 ceiling text consigns wholesale to UNKNOWN. If the ceiling is read as bounding what conclusions are attainable, this exceeds it; if read as bounding only interpretation-resolution, the ceiling should be re-frozen to say so — either way the frozen statement is falsified as the least upper bound on conclusion-level correctness.

CEILING-FALSIFICATION ATTEMPT on the residue clause: the frozen statement fixes byte-identity 'within the pinned hardware/software class' and names cross-hardware bit-portability as the irreducible residue, 'handled by record/replay.' But the trusted path in this design is defined over CakeML's formally specified machine semantics with integer/symbolic-only arithmetic, single-threaded deterministic evaluation, and reified merge schedules — a semantics with NO hardware-dependent observable (no floats, no timing, no memory-layout leakage into values). For such a kernel, bit-identity of trusted outputs holds across ANY conforming hardware, and conformance violations are detected by AX-13 recompute-and-compare. The residue shrinks from 'cross-hardware portability is unattainable, use record/replay' to 'hardware faults only' — i.e., the pinned-class qualifier is a property of undisciplined kernels, not a ceiling for all H1-H8 systems.

CEILING-FALSIFICATION ATTEMPT on the impossibility clause 'No system can make wall-clock seconds offline-verifiable with zero trust in ANY party': a verifiable delay function (Wesolowski/Pietrzak-class, deployed today) yields an offline-checkable proof that at least T sequential squarings elapsed between two committed events — trusting NO party, only the sequentiality assumption and a committed conservative bound on the fastest physically realizable sequential squaring rate. That converts to a wall-clock LOWER bound in seconds with zero party trust — a hardware-speed constant is a physical/technological assumption, not a party. If judges accept that distinction, the frozen clause is false for the lower-bound half of the bracket (upper bounds still need the external time quorum, which the design also carries); at minimum the ceiling's 'zero trust in ANY party' should be re-frozen as 'zero trust in any party for upper bounds; assumption-bounded for lower bounds.'

ATTAINMENT-FLOOR ATTACK rather than a bound falsification (filed for the record): the frozen ceiling concedes sublinear zero-producer-trust verification via transparent proof systems is 'not cryptographically excluded' but treats the per-byte read-and-hash recompute floor as operative for the declared toolchain. K-SUP is the one class free to DECLARE its toolchain, and it declares an arithmetized pipeline for the hot verification path — making sublinear third-party verification operative, not hypothetical. This does not exceed the frozen guarantee (which is resource-parameterized) but it strictly exceeds the operative floor of every fixed-toolchain class in the tournament, and under incomparable_rule S1 that difference is a real axis advantage, not a footnote.

envelope_attack:
The strongest case that the per-dimension join FAILS — that ceiling-envelope synthesis loses something no per-axis reading reveals — has four prongs, each anchored to a concrete seam in this very design.

(1) OPERATING-MODEL EQUIVOCATION AT THE SERIALIZATION POINT (DIM-09 seam). The AX-15 ceiling is explicitly frozen 'on the declared operating model (single node, POSIX, commodity SSD)'; the AX-07/AX-08/AX-12 equivocation clauses reach their maxima only via replication or witness quorums. The envelope claims both by offering Mode A and Mode B — but a deployed instance runs ONE mode. In Mode A, split-view resistance depends on a LIVE external witness quorum (a deployment resource whose liveness is outside the AX-16 budget discipline: a dead quorum forces either fail-closed unavailability or silent fallback to fork-consistency — the first costs the AX-16 rung operationally, the second is exactly the silent downgrade H3 forbids). In Mode B, the AX-15 R5 claim rests on a declared model the system no longer inhabits, and the exact-cost certificates of AX-17 must now meter consensus retry counts that are functions of adversarial network scheduling — 'every quantile a theorem' survives only by exiling consensus cost from the certified quantity, which narrows the AX-17 claim precisely where the join made it interesting. The join attains max(rank_TLOG, rank_BFT) per axis only by quantifying over deployments — no single deployment holds the whole vector, and the tournament compares deployable architectures, not unions of them.

(2) ERASURE VERSUS TOTAL REPLAY (AX-07 × AX-13 × AX-06). The salted-commitment erasure mechanism and 'a third party replays the ENTIRE derivation chain offline' cannot both be read at full strength: after a lawful erasure, recompute-and-compare is impossible for every derivation that consumed the erased body. My declared composition rule (STABLE-over-erasure or UNKNOWN-REDACTED) is honest, but it is strictly weaker than AX-13's frozen R5 read in isolation — the envelope quietly re-scopes 'entire chain' to 'entire unredacted chain plus stability certificates.' A per-axis ceiling reader would never see this loss; the join forces it. If the judges hold AX-13 R5 to its letter, the envelope's AX-13 claim degrades to a KNOWN_UPPER_BOUND on erasure-touched corpora.

(3) BUDGET-COUPLING OF THE AX-01 CROWN. The R5 semantics-above-grounded rung is claimed under a declared AX-17 budget, fail-closed on breach. On workloads whose even-cycle escalations systematically exceed the budget, every such query returns typed REFUSED — H1-H8-compliant, but the system then IS a grounded-rung system (AX-01 R4 per the ladder's own sentence) on exactly the query class that justified the R5 claim. The envelope's AX-01 and AX-17 rungs are simultaneously attainable only relative to a workload distribution; an adversary picks the workload. The join holds per-axis maxima pointwise but not uniformly — and the freeze has no place to record 'R5 on affordable queries.'

(4) THE UNKNOWN_RULE AS THE REAL KILLER. Every mechanism above is buildable today, but the CONJUNCTION is a multi-year proof-and-engineering program (AX-21 refinement chain, AX-15 verified recovery, AX-22 parametricity proof, AX-10 executed campaigns). Under the unknown_rule, ranks without independently recomputable evidence score UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN blocks every pairwise comparison. K-SUP therefore cannot WIN round 1; at best it survives as undominated-with-UNKNOWNs while a smaller class with executing witnesses (K-B0-SHIPPED) holds KNOWN ranks. The envelope's true tournament function may not be to win but to serve as the standing synthesis obligation that forces every winner to justify each axis where it sits below the join — and an architecture whose best case is 'obligatory yardstick' has, in the tournament's own non-compensatory terms, not yet earned a single decided axis. That is the honest attack: the join is coherent on paper, loses letter-strength at two identified seams (1)-(2), holds one crown only distribution-relatively (3), and is evidentially UNKNOWN almost everywhere until built (4).

design:
# K-ARG/Ω — Chartered Certified-Argumentation Institution (CCAI)

**Class thesis.** Law is not a calculator with exceptions bolted on; it is a defeat structure. Every hard invariant of THE LEGAL WATCHTOWER (H1–H8) is *easier*, not harder, to discharge when the single reasoning substrate is certified structured argumentation, because the substrate's native objects — rules, attacks, priorities, undecidedness — are exactly the objects the ceilings demand certificates for. CCAI re-derives A3 (NIATM) with the CDAI contradiction-resolutions folded in, and closes NIATM's recorded failures (O5 determinism, O6 durability, O7 acquisition, O12 cost) at their seats.

## 1. Committed base and admission (DIM-02, DIM-16)
- Every source enters only through a **typed, signed admission act** appended to the record: source bytes (content-addressed, digests, capture custody), formal rules, priority meta-rules, interpretive-stance arguments, legal-order profiles.
- Rules are **ASPIC+-typed** (strict vs defeasible, with undercutter/rebuttal/premise-attack declarations), serialized in LegalRuleML, each bound by a signed record to its natural-language source span. Formalization admission = **LLM-as-untrusted-parser proposals → n-version formalization diff (independent formalizers; any semantic diff blocks) → human authority gate** (H1: no LLM in the trusted path; the human signature, not the model, is the admission basis).
- **Priorities are defeasible, attackable meta-rules** (lex superior/posterior/specialis as arguments), never hardcoded — the NIATM insight that legal meta-norms are themselves contestable.
- Verified statutory computations (Catala-class outputs, arithmetic subroutines) are admitted as **strict rules with attached derivation certificates** — the class absorbs calculus results as premises without ceding the defeat calculus.

## 2. Record and state (DIM-05, DIM-07, DIM-10) — closes NIATM O5/O6
- **One append-only, hash-chained, single-writer record**; every admitted entry has seq' = seq+1; commit is a **single atomic root-pointer switch** (write-new, fsync file + directory, pointer rename) so recovery after crash at any instant is exactly σ_pre or σ_post.
- **Monotone record, non-monotone conclusions** (CDAI Contradiction 1): retraction/defeat is *appending a defeater*. The record never shrinks; all non-monotonicity lives inside the pure kernel.
- **Institutional state = K_v(record-prefix)**: a pure, total, terminating function (ACL2-class admissibility obligations: mechanical termination proof per kernel function). No wall clock, RNG, or IO inside K_v; knowledge time IS the prefix length.
- The **self-model is propositions in the same store**, derived by the same kernel, defeasible by the same mechanics (CDAI Contradiction 4): coverage gaps, source-vitality findings, and Inspectorate findings are arguments; a finding of procedural invalidity *attacks* (suspends) the publication power.

## 3. The certified semantics core (DIM-01) — the home axis
- K_v compiles the admitted ASPIC+ theory at a query's declared legal time into an abstract argumentation framework (AF), with temporalised-defeasible-logic validity intervals selecting which rules exist at t_legal (abrogation ≠ annulment; retroactivity modeled natively).

Budget breach → typed REFUSED-BUDGET, fail-closed, never silent degradation. This is exactly the AX-01 R5 rung: unique-status semantics strictly above grounded, decidable on the finite committed base, certificate-carrying.

## 4. Ignorance with witnesses (DIM-12) — closes NIATM O12/O4
Closed, committed UNKNOWN taxonomy, every branch **witness-carrying**:
- UNKNOWN-INPUT: missing/unformalized source; witness = the coverage-gap object (which enumeration/reference/cadence closure failed).
- UNDEC-SEMANTIC: grounded-undecided; witness = the even-cycle attack subgraph itself.
- CONTESTED-INTERPRETATION: witness = the interpretive fork — the competing admitted stance-arguments (Sartor/Macagno interpretive schemes as first-class arguments), plus per-stance conditional answers.
- REFUSED-BUDGET: witness = the recomputable cost certificate exceeding the committed budget.
**Stability engine**: necessary-acceptance over incomplete AFs yields PASS/FAIL-STABLE-OVER-UNKNOWNS verdicts — a verdict certified invariant under all completions of the unknown inputs, discharging the four-verdict ceiling of AX-09.

## 5. Citation and authority (DIM-03)
Grammar-total recognizer per legal-order profile; every string in L(G) resolves to exactly one committed authority record with a signed receipt (key chain, bitemporal validity at the citation's reference time); out-of-grammar citation-likes are typed UNKNOWN-CITATION. **Citator coupling is generative**: a committed "overruled/repealed" treatment record automatically *emits a defeater* against every argument resting on that authority — authority decay propagates by semantics, not by re-review.

## 6. Institutional authority (DIM-05 / AX-12)
Jones–Sergot **institutionalised power**: offices hold typed, exclusive powers; counts-as classifies acts; an act without power is **VOID — it cannot execute** (warrant checks must unanimously pass before any state-changing method runs). One physical order, many constitutional authorities (CDAI Contradiction 3). Decisions are inadmissible unless they name an **executable reopening predicate** (their own falsifier).

## 7. Adversarial layer (DIM-13)
Fresh-context critics (no implementer rationale) file **attack arguments into the same record**; n-version formalization diffing at admission; kernel-checked counterexamples. An unresolved attack blocks the conclusion *by the semantics itself* (an undischarged defeater defeats) — fail-closed blocking is not process discipline, it is the acceptance relation.

## 8. Evolution (DIM-14)
Kernel versioning (CDAI Contradiction 2): K_v → K_v′ never rewrites history; it yields a second interpretation of the same record, and every difference is a first-class **DIVERGENCE object that must itself be adjudicated** before promotion. Promotion is a warranted transition gated by the **floor-vector ratchet** (recompute previous floors, prove pointwise non-regression).

## 9. Offline verification kit (H8)
Verifier = (checker binary + record bytes). A third party recomputes the hash chain, replays K_v over any prefix, re-checks every acceptance certificate and every LRAT proof — zero producer trust. The explanation shipped to users **is** the certificate (dialectical tree rendering of the very proof object), so explanation/decision divergence is structurally impossible.

The per-dimension join (K-SUP) treats the 22 ceilings as independently maximizable coordinates and stitches the per-axis best mechanisms. Three structural failures follow.

# VSC-Ω — The Promulgated Verified Statutory Calculus (K-CAT steelman)

**One sentence.** A Catala-class prioritized-default calculus, mechanized in F* and transported through a CakeML-verified compilation chain, wrapped in a single-writer certificate-carrying institution whose every trusted artifact — statute bytes, formalization, compiled binary, query answer, cost bound, evolution step — is a pure, total, offline-replayable derivation; where the legal order permits it, the calculus text is itself the promulgated operative law (the DGFiP cell), dissolving rather than bounding the formalization gap.

## A. Kernel calculus (DIM-01: prioritized-default-verified-calculus)
- Surface language: literate, statute-isomorphic scopes (Catala-class): each rule is lexically nested under the pinpoint statutory span it implements; defaults + exception trees + explicit priority orders are typed objects.
- Desugars to the default calculus (δ-calc) with an F*-mechanized semantics; proven-sound compilation δ→λ (the ICFP'21 Catala artifact; extended kernel per the "Closing the Loop" line, arXiv 2606.23913). EXECUTING WITNESS exists.
- **Totality by construction**: no general recursion, structural recursion and bounded iteration only; strong normalization of δ-calc is a mechanizable theorem. Conflict-between-exceptions and missing-definition are typed errors, fail-closed (H3) — an undischarged applicable exception can never be silently ignored: exception search is exhaustive over the statically committed exception tree.
- Honest scope: defeasibility is prioritized defaults, NOT an argumentation defeat calculus; even-attack-cycle norm conflicts compile to typed CONFLICT/UNKNOWN, never to a decided answer. The AX-01 semantics gap vs ideal/eager is **recorded, not hidden**.

## B. Verified transport (DIM-06: verified-kernel-chain)
- Backend retarget: λ-calc → CakeML source, with one new mechanized semantics-preservation proof (HOL4) — then CakeML's verified, bootstrapped compiler to machine code. This is exactly the superior transport the frozen AX-21 ceiling names as reachable today.
- The interpreter, the abstract cost meter, and the certificate checker live inside the same verified image. TCB: F*/HOL4 proof-checker kernels + CakeML binary + hardware — enumerated, minimized, hash-committed.
- Third party re-checks: re-run F* and HOL4 proofs offline; recompute-and-compare every build step. (New proofs = WOULD_NEED_BUILD, flagged per-axis.)

## C. Corpus, citation, time (DIM-02/03/04)
- Hash-committed **legal-order profile** as data: citation grammar G, gazette/publisher identity and keys, calendar, language normalization, deontic lexicon. No order-specific logic in the mechanism.
- Admission of source bytes: publisher signature verification where the gazette signs (eIDAS-class), else k-of-n independent capture witnesses and/or TLS-oracle attested capture; below that, typed UNKNOWN/provisional. Merkle-committed corpus; selection by exact committed identifier only (corpus-size independence, H4).
- Every rule's admission record binds it by digest to the pinpoint span of admitted authority bytes → grounding and citation certificates are derivation-provenance lookups, decidable with zero LLM (the AX-05 ceiling's formal-object half, which this class maximizes).
- **Bitemporal statute store**: every rule carries a valid-time interval and knowledge-time of admission; typed amendment events under a declared formal amendment semantics; every query evaluated at a declared (t_legal, t_knowledge) pair and replayable at that pair; anachronistic derivation is a type error.

## D. Formalization admission (DIM-16 — the class's trust masterstroke)
Two sub-cells, explicitly typed and never conflated:
1. **Publisher-authoritative formal law** (DGFiP/CNAF cell): the executable calculus text is what the authority promulgates and runs; the formalization IS the operative law. Formalization-correctness residual on this cell: zero by identity, not by verification.
2. **Privately authored codification**: human-gated admission ceremony — **n-version independent formalization** (≥2 teams, fresh context), structural diff of compiled δ-terms plus differential testing over committed generated input vectors; any divergence is a typed, blocking obligation; accountable human sign-off recorded as a certificate-carrying transition. Interpretively contested text is typed UNKNOWN at admission, never guessed (H1/H2).

## E. Institution shell (DIM-05/07/08/10)
- **Single physical writer seat**; every trusted state transition passes one total decidable kernel predicate K(state, transition, cert) BEFORE canonicalization; acceptance ⇒ certificate-carrying commit with seq' = seq+1; every other outcome a recorded signed refusal with zero state change.
- Append-only hash-chained episode log (salted per-leaf commitments for lawful-erasure certificates); atomic single-commit-point store (WAL + fsync barriers + atomic rename; recovery procedure verified FSCQ-style — build item); read-back recompute-and-compare before a commit counts.
- **Per-step recompute DAG** over the entire pipeline: parse→desugar→typecheck→δ→λ→CakeML→binary, and every query evaluation, each step committed as (input-hash, deterministic-transform-id, output-hash) under a Merkle root inside the signed release identity. Per-release and per-answer offline replay bundles: a third party with only the bundle recomputes everything bit-for-bit with zero producer trust.

## F. Verdict discipline (DIM-12)
Four verdict classes, total: PASS + recomputable certificate; FAIL/CONFLICT + counter-certificate (the conflicting exception pair, the violated priority); **STABLE-OVER-UNKNOWN** + invariance certificate — verdict proven identical under all completions of unknown inputs, by exhaustive enumeration over typed finite domains and SMT (QF_LIA dates/amounts) over the compiled term; typed UNKNOWN + reason from a closed committed enumeration. Nothing outside the decidable class ever upgrades.

## G. Adversarial regime (DIM-13)
Committed, hash-frozen mutation-operator class over the δ-AST (priority flip, exception drop, threshold/boundary shift, date off-by-one, scope-call rewiring); deterministic mutant generation ⇒ the kill matrix is itself a committed replayable derivation; a surviving mutant is a typed UNKNOWN that blocks release fail-closed. Independent fresh-context counter-review is a blocking admission gate; findings ledger append-only with terminal dispositions.

## H. Evolution ratchet (DIM-14: 'Closing the Loop' reward kernel)
Untrusted proposers (including LLMs, strictly outside the trusted path per H1) may propose rule patches, refactorings, optimizations. Admission requires: recomputed floor census pointwise ≥ previous release; re-checked preservation/refinement proofs for every committed spec'd behavior class; clean n-version diff; human sign-off. The certified set only grows; a step that cannot prove preservation is refused fail-closed (H3/H7).

## I. Cost, liveness, throughput (AX-16/17/18)
Totality pays here: every compiled scope has a **static worst-case cost theorem** (∀-input bound), plus a deterministic abstract cost meter recomputable to bit-equality per run, plus a fail-closed committed budget gate. Liveness: the calculus terminates by theorem; the only waits are at commit/IO boundaries, each typed with a budget; a stall is a certificate-carrying state. Throughput: deterministic parallel map over independent queries, ordered serial fold at the single commit seat, batched Merkle appends.

## J. Multi-order (DIM-15)
One compiler, zero mechanism change across orders — witnessed today by French tax/family-benefits statutes and US IRC §121 formalizations in the same public toolchain; order content lives entirely in profiles + admitted formalized sources.

**Buildability statement.** Existing today: Catala compiler + F* soundness artifact, DGFiP/CNAF-class deployments, CakeML/HOL4, Merkle/signature commodity crypto, SMT solvers, FSCQ-class verified-storage technique, multi-order witness in-repo. Genuinely new proofs (flagged WOULD_NEED_BUILD in the profile): λ→CakeML preservation, mechanized strong normalization + end-to-end purity, verified store recovery, certified cost envelope, formalized authority model. No vaporware: every such proof is of a small total object — which is precisely why this class, uniquely, can afford them.

design:
# PCK — Precedential Constraint Kernel (K-CBR steelman)

A proof-carrying common-law reasoner in which the ONLY trusted interpretive artifacts are per-span factor ascriptions and recorded outcomes; no authored rulebase exists in the trusted path. Everything below is buildable today with published, decidable theory (Horty 2011/2012 result+reason models; Horty–Bench-Capon 2012; HYPO dimensions per Horty 2019/Rigoni 2018; CATO hierarchies; hierarchical precedential constraint, van Woerkom et al. ICAIL 2023; Prakken 2021 AF reconstruction; Carneades proof standards).

## 1. Committed artifacts (all hash-committed under one Merkle root inside the signed release identity)
- **Opinion corpus** (DIM-02/AX-04): capture records of court-opinion bytes — publisher signature where available, else k-of-n capture-witness corroboration; dual digest with deterministic extraction E(bytes)=text; membership by Merkle inclusion, selection only by committed identifier.
- **Legal-order profile** (DIM-15/AX-22): hash-committed data — factor schema (factor id, polarity per issue, HYPO dimensions with committed value orders, CATO hierarchy edges), per-issue Carneades proof standard + burden allocation, court-hierarchy graph with temporal validity, stare-decisis strength tiers, citation grammar G for case citations. The engine contains zero order-specific logic.
- **Case records**: {case-id, court, dates, per issue: factor set where EVERY factor carries a pinpoint span digest into the captured opinion bytes + the signing curator's identity; outcome; optional reason set (Horty reason model as a strictly-stronger optional layer); treatment events (overruled/limited/questioned) as typed bitemporal events}.
- **Ascription acts** (DIM-16): factor ascription is the single interpretive trust surface. Humans ascribe and sign; an LLM may PROPOSE ascriptions only as untrusted candidates outside the trusted path (H1) — nothing enters the constraining computation without a signed admission transition through the kernel predicate. Curator disagreement = typed CONTESTED ascription → the factor enters as UNKNOWN and flows into stability analysis rather than being resolved by fiat.

## 2. Trusted engine (pure total functions of the frozen closure)
- **forcing(q, CB@(t_legal,t_know), profile)**: compute the constraining set (filter by court-hierarchy bindingness, temporal validity, treatment state at the queried bitemporal pair); test a-fortiori dominance Pro_s(Y)⊆Pro_s(X) ∧ Opp_s(X)⊆Opp_s(Y), lifted through the CATO hierarchy (hierarchical constraint) and through dimension value-orders. Output per issue: **FORCED_π / FORCED_δ / OPEN / INCONSISTENT-CB** — the OPEN verdict is a certified legal-content answer ("either outcome is consistent with the committed case base": where binding law ends and discretion begins), distinct from typed UNKNOWN (ignorance).
- **Semantics** (AX-01): FORCED(s) iff s holds in EVERY case-base-consistent decision of X — sceptical quantification, per-query unique, deterministic, decidable O(|CB|·|F|). Certificates in BOTH directions: FORCED carries the dominating precedent + dominance trace; NOT-FORCED carries an explicit consistent counter-decision witness plus an exhaustive-scan record naming, for every binding precedent, the factor that breaks dominance. Defeater search is total over the committed base by construction.
- **consistency(CB)**: pairwise dominance-conflict scan; INCONSISTENT verdicts carry a kernel-checked counterexample pair (DIM-13).
- **stability(q with UNKNOWN ascriptions)** (DIM-12, AX-09 v2 carve-out): by the monotonicity of dominance in factor presence, verdict stability over ALL completions reduces to checking ONE extremal completion (all unknown opponent-side factors present, all unknown own-side factors absent) — polynomial, not 2^u. When stable: KNOWN-with-stability-certificate. Optional flip-set frontier (all minimal unknown-ascription sets that flip the verdict) computed under a committed AX-17 budget; beyond budget → typed UNKNOWN(BUDGET-EXCEEDED), never a guess.
- **Proof standards**: per-issue Carneades evaluation (standard + burden from the profile) over the structured issue graph — decidable, deterministic.
- **Certificates**: canonical encoding at ONE serialization seat (H4); an independent offline checker (small, producer-free) re-verifies subset/dominance comparisons, hierarchy/dimension lifts, scan completeness against the committed Merkle leaves, extremal-completion stability, and bitemporal filters — zero producer trust (H8).

## 3. Substrate
Single-writer append-only hash-chained ledger; one decidable kernel admission predicate evaluated BEFORE canonicalization; all-or-nothing commits (WAL + atomic rename + read-back verify); every commit certificate-carrying and sequence-monotonic; deterministic parallel map over precedents with ordered serial fold; all nondeterminism sources reified in the committed closure; external fetches quarantined outside the trusted path with typed timeout obligations, fail-closed.

## 4. Adversarial + evolution
Committed finite mutation class M over the (small) engine: comparator flips, scan truncation, treatment-ignore, hierarchy-bypass, temporal-bypass, standard-swap, subset-direction inversion; 100% kill matrix as an offline-recomputable release artifact; independent fresh-context counter-design as blocking admission gate; every finding gets an append-only terminal disposition. Floor vector = gold corpus of FORCED/OPEN/INCONSISTENT/stability verdicts + invariant checks; ratchet-monotone admission of every evolution step (DIM-14).

## 5. Honest gaps, stated
(a) Factor-ascription CORRECTNESS is human-curated — the system certifies constraint relative to signed ascriptions, never that ascriptions read the opinion rightly; this is the class's known gap and it is strictly smaller than rulebase-authoring correctness (one per-span, per-signature auditable act vs. an authored defeasible theory). (b) Case-base coverage is a committed census: verdicts are certified relative to the committed CB, with the frontier stated in the certificate. (c) AX-21 verification and the AX-10 kill-matrix runs are specified but not yet executed — marked WOULD_NEED_BUILD below, honestly.

axis_profile.mechanism: Forcing = sceptical quantification over all case-base-consistent decisions: per-query unique, deterministic, decidable O(|CB|*|F|) on the finite committed base. Certificates both directions (a-fortiori dominance trace for FORCED; consistent counter-decision witness + exhaustive broken-dominance scan for NOT-FORCED); defeater search total over the committed base by construction; unascribed/contested factors typed UNKNOWN. Strictly stronger than grounded on Prakken's derived AF: equal-rank conflicting precedent pairs form even attack cycles grounded leaves undefined, while sceptical forcing still decides every dominated query.

Static finite typed dataflow DAG (capture -> ascription admission -> constraining set -> forcing/stability -> certificate) committed as data; typed pre/postconditions per stage; a checker verifies composed postconditions entail the declared goal-artifact set; entailment gaps surface as typed UNKNOWN obligations. R5 verified plan calculus not claimed.

Physical single-writer seat: no concurrent trusted writers exist, so deadlock/lost-update/unarbitrated-conflict classes are structurally absent (the protocol proof is a short machine-checked lemma over a degenerate one-seat protocol); every admission ordering decision is a certificate-carrying hash-chained commit, offline replayable by re-folding the ledger; nonforking checked by chain verification.

Every factor in every constraining computation chains factor -> signed ascription -> pinpoint span digest -> dual-digest capture record -> Merkle inclusion in the frozen corpus root; selection only by committed identifier (corpus-size independent); the offline checker re-verifies the whole grounding chain with zero producer trust; ungrounded claims cannot enter the engine by type.

Grammar-total recognizer for the profile's case-citation grammar G (DIM-03); every cited case resolves to exactly one committed case record with verified receipt; citations bind proposition, pinpoint span, and authority status at the stated (t_legal,t_know) INCLUDING subsequent treatment - overruling/limiting are first-class typed bitemporal events that mechanically shrink the constraining set, so negative-treatment checking is native, not bolted on; strings outside L(G) are typed UNKNOWN-CITATION.

All transformations (extraction E, constraining-set filter, forcing, stability, certificate emission) are committed pure steps (input-hash, transformation-id, output-hash) under a domain-separated Merkle root in the signed release identity; a third party re-derives every artifact from recorded inputs and byte-compares; any incomplete chain is inadmissible.

Matter/case state is canonical typed records admitted only through the kernel predicate, each write an all-or-nothing accountable transition (H6) on the hash-chained ledger; reflective entries (kill matrices, finding dispositions, consistency counterexamples, gold-corpus results) are themselves committed recomputable artifacts, verified and offline replayable; recall is a pure function of the committed prefix, typed UNKNOWN for the uncommitted.

The class is natively bitemporal: the constraining set at (t_legal, t_know) is computed from typed validity intervals, decision dates, and treatment events committed by t_know; anachronistic constraint (citing a precedent not yet decided, or one already overruled at t_legal) is structurally excluded by the filter, and every verdict certificate names its (t_legal, t_know) pair and replays at it.

Total verdict algebra per issue: FORCED-with-certificate; INCONSISTENT-with-kernel-checked-counterexample-pair; KNOWN-with-stability-certificate over UNKNOWN ascriptions (extremal-completion monotonicity lemma makes the all-completions check polynomial - one worst-case completion suffices); typed UNKNOWN with a closed committed reason enumeration (UNASCRIBED, CONTESTED-ASCRIPTION, NO-PROFILE, OUT-OF-CENSUS, BUDGET-EXCEEDED); plus certified OPEN (legal discretion) as a distinct content verdict. Every certificate delimits the verified region (the committed CB census); guessing is structurally impossible.

Committed finite mutation class M over the small engine (comparator flip, scan truncation, treatment-ignore, hierarchy-bypass, temporal-bypass, standard-swap, subset inversion) with 100% kill required, kill matrix an offline-recomputable release artifact; independent fresh-context counter-design as a blocking admission gate; any unresolved finding or surviving mutant blocks release fail-closed and escalates as a typed certificate-carrying obligation. Mechanism fully specified and wired into the admission gate, but the runs and kill matrices do not yet exist.

All controlled-media effects go through the single-writer atomic commit (WAL + atomic rename + read-back verify): exactly sigma_pre or sigma_post after any crash; every commit certificate-carrying in a monotonic sequence and offline replayable; external fetches (uncontrolled media) are journaled intent/outcome with idempotency keys, structurally outside the atomic section, unknowable outcomes parked as typed UNKNOWN.

One total decidable kernel predicate K(state, transition, certificate) at the single serialization seat; every transition (case admission, ascription, treatment event, schema change, evolution step) is all-or-nothing and records the authorizing principal (signing curator/creator), basis, and certificate non-repudiably; every non-acceptance is a recorded signed refusal with zero state change. R5 (verified authority model) not claimed - the formalization artifact does not exist.

Every verdict certificate binds, via hash commitments, the complete derivation closure (corpus root, profile hash, case-ledger head, engine code identity, query, budgets); a third party holding certificate + committed closure recomputes forcing/stability/consistency to bit-equality fully offline - the engine is a pure total function and the independent checker shares no code with the producer.

Trusted decisions are pure functions of the frozen closure by construction: no wall-clock (legal/knowledge times are query INPUTS), no RNG (deterministic tie-break by case-id ordering), no IO in the engine; nondeterministic sources (fetches, curator input) cross the boundary only as committed bytes via recorded admission events. R5 machine-verified purity not claimed - the end-to-end effect-system verification artifact does not exist.

WAL with fsync of file and directory before acknowledgment; single-file atomic-rename commit point; read-back recompute-and-compare before a transition counts committed; recovery replays the journal to exactly the committed prefix - torn transitions unobservable. R5 verified-recovery-procedure bound not claimed.

The entire trusted path is total structural recursion over finite committed data (scan over |CB|, factors over |F|, one extremal completion) - termination by construction, provable by structural induction; every blocking point (external fetch, curator wait) is outside the trusted path, typed with a progress obligation and per-task budget; budget breach terminates fail-closed with a typed violation, never a silent hang.

Closed-form derivable envelopes: forcing O(|CB|*|F|), consistency O(|CB|^2*|F|), stability O(|CB|*|F|) via the extremal-completion lemma, flip-set frontier explicitly budget-bounded; the engine emits deterministic abstract op-count cost certificates any third party recomputes to bit-equality; a fail-closed budget gate blocks any run exceeding its committed budget (excess returns typed UNKNOWN(BUDGET-EXCEEDED), never silent degradation).

Scaling classes derived from the architecture, not measured: deterministic parallel map over precedents (embarrassingly parallel dominance tests) with ordered serial fold; T_p >= max(W/p, S, batched serialization floor); saturation point = the single-writer append seat, identified and batched. R5 certified envelope with accountable saturation behavior not claimed at design stage.

The explanation IS the certificate: the dominating precedent with its a-fortiori factor mapping, the CATO-hierarchy distinction/emphasis paths for every non-dominating on-point case, the counter-decision witness for OPEN verdicts, and the stability analysis answering which-inputs-mattered and what-would-change EXACTLY (which contested ascriptions can flip the outcome). This is mechanically the 3-ply HYPO cite/distinguish argument structure - the native genre of common-law justification - and divergence from the decision is structurally impossible because there is no second explanation generator.

Floor vector = committed gold corpus of FORCED/OPEN/INCONSISTENT/stability verdicts plus executable invariant checks; every evolution step (engine change, schema version, profile change) is an admitted transition whose certificate recomputes the previous floors from the hash-chained census and proves pointwise non-regression before admission; failures refuse fail-closed. R5 preservation-proof coverage of infinite behavior classes not claimed.

The core theory is one page of decidable definitions (dominance, forcing, consistency, hierarchical lift, extremal-completion stability) - unusually amenable to full formalization; the plan commits to mechanizing the model and the engine's key invariants (soundness/completeness of forcing vs the sceptical quantification, the monotonicity lemma) in a proof assistant. No proof artifact exists today, hence WOULD_NEED_BUILD; R2 reviewed-specs is what the design entails as-is.

All order-specific content (factor schema, hierarchy graph, citation grammar, proof standards, stare-decisis strength, calendar) is data behind the hash-committed legal-order profile; the engine is a single function of the profile with no order-specific branch; an order without a well-formed profile yields typed UNKNOWN. R4 requires an independently verified two-order demonstration, which does not exist yet.

exceed_claims.claim: The frozen ceiling fixes its frame as acceptance 'over an explicitly committed, finite, defeasible RULEBASE' and declares the NL-to-rule formalization step forever unguaranteeable. K-CBR falsifies the FRAME's optimality for the case-law cell: Horty's result model yields sound, complete, certificate-carrying sceptical constraint from (facts, outcome) pairs ALONE - no authored rulebase exists, so the unguaranteeable formalization residue shrinks from 'correctness of an authored defeasible theory' to 'correctness of per-span factor ascriptions', a strictly smaller, per-signature-auditable interpretive act. Measured as trusted legal content per unit of unverifiable human interpretation, the attainable maximum on the case-law workload is strictly higher than the rulebase-relative ceiling implies. Additionally, the ceiling's verdict algebra omits certified OPEN (either outcome consistent with committed law) - a content-level answer distinct from both PASS and UNKNOWN that no rulebase semantics emits: a rulebase either derives or is ignorant; it cannot certify permissibility-of-either-outcome.

The ceiling's stability carve-out describes a binary KNOWN-with-stability-certificate quantified over ALL completions, implicitly priced at completion enumeration. K-CBR exceeds it two ways: (1) COST - by the lattice monotonicity of dominance in factor presence, stability over all 2^u completions reduces to ONE extremal completion check, making the carve-out polynomial where a generic rule substrate faces exponential completion spaces; (2) CONTENT - the flip-set frontier (all minimal sets of contested/unknown ascriptions whose resolution changes the verdict) is a certified object strictly richer than the ceiling's binary stable/unknown dichotomy: it tells the accountable human exactly which interpretive disputes are outcome-relevant and which are moot. The frozen maximum under-describes what is attainable in verdict-class information content.

The ceiling caps machine authority at 'authorization and process compliance, never the substantive rightness of the institutional decision itself.' For the a-fortiori-forced subclass, K-CBR machine-certifies a SUBSTANTIVE legal-content property: that deciding otherwise is inconsistent with the committed case base under the committed protected-reasons model - a claim about what the law requires, not about who was authorized. The certificate is relative to committed ascriptions (so it is not absolute rightness), but the ceiling's boundary as frozen draws the machine/human line below where a decidable, offline-checkable substantive-bindingness certificate demonstrably exists; the boundary clause should read 'never substantive rightness BEYOND committed-model-relative forcedness.'

The ceiling asserts 'mechanism-level universality is attainable, semantic-level universality is not - there exists no jurisdiction-free formal semantics of law.' For the precedent cell this is falsified in part: the constraint relation itself (a-fortiori dominance and sceptical forcing) is jurisdiction-free mathematics over any factor vocabulary with polarities; the profile carries only vocabulary, hierarchy, and a stare-decisis strength parameter. That is a SEMANTIC invariant across legal orders (the same formal semantics of precedent constraint instantiates common-law binding precedent and civil-law jurisprudence constante by parameter, not by new semantics), so the semantic residue on this cell is strictly narrower than the ceiling's blanket negative.

envelope_attack: A per-dimension ceiling-envelope join fails against K-CBR for four structural reasons. (1) ENTANGLEMENT OF DIM-12 WITH DIM-01: the stability rung K-CBR holds (KNOWN-with-stability-certificate, polynomial via the extremal-completion monotonicity lemma) is a theorem ABOUT the precedent lattice, not a detachable module. Graft AX-09-max onto the envelope's AX-01-max substrate (a committed defeasible rulebase under ideal/sceptical-preferred semantics) and the unknown-completion space becomes the rulebase's semantic space, where no monotone extremal completion exists and invariance-under-all-completions reverts to exponential enumeration or trivial cases - the join keeps the rung's label and loses its mechanism. (2) THE INTERPRETIVE-ECONOMY PROPERTY IS NOT ON ANY AXIS: every envelope guarantee is conditioned on artifacts whose authoring is the single highest-risk act the taxonomy itself flags (DIM-16: the committed formal rulebase). K-CBR's guarantees are conditioned only on per-span, per-signature factor ascriptions - a strictly smaller trusted interpretive surface. A per-axis max join inherits the LARGEST interpretive surface of its donors, because the AX-01 donor's semantics does not run without its rulebase; the join is therefore strictly worse than K-CBR on a property the lattice does not measure but H1-honesty makes decisive: how much unverifiable human interpretation sits under every certificate. (3) THE CERTIFIED-OPEN VERDICT HAS NO ENVELOPE SOURCE: only quantification over all case-base-consistent decisions yields the certified boundary between binding law and discretion (FORCED vs OPEN). A rulebase substrate emits derivations and UNKNOWNs; it cannot certify 'either outcome is legally permissible.' To supply this verdict class, the envelope must import the precedent model whole - constraining set, dominance, hierarchy, treatment - at which point the 'synthesis' contains K-CBR as an undigested subsystem and inherits its curated-ascription gap anyway: the envelope does not dominate K-CBR, it federates with it. (4) WORKLOAD-CELL RELATIVITY OF THE ORDER: axis ranks are attained relative to declared workload cells, and K-CBR is the only surviving class holding the case-law/common-law cell (REGION U_T per the closure). # NSV-MAX — the strongest Propose/Verify-Out Neuro-Symbolic Pipeline

**Thesis.** The weak form (R5 A5 RAE) failed because model emissions could *become* premises. NSV-MAX makes that structurally impossible: there are exactly two planes and one gate, and **no byte authored by a statistical producer ever becomes canonical except as the checked payload of a certificate that a deterministic kernel recomputed**. The LLM is an oracle for *where to look*, never for *what is true*. Every mechanism below is buildable today from named components; the three artifacts that are spec-only are enumerated in §12 and tagged WOULD_NEED_BUILD in the axis profile.

## 1. Trust topology
- **Proposer Plane P (untrusted, parallel, replayable):** an ensemble of pinned open-weight LLMs (weights hash-committed; batch-invariant inference kernels per the AX-14 v2 determinization retraction, so every proposal is a pure function of the committed prompt closure within a pinned hardware class; where cross-hardware portability is needed, the candidate bytes themselves are committed — record/replay). Roles: retrieval proposer, autoformalizer, lemma-DAG planner, proof-search policy (test-time proof search), counterexample/attack proposer, verbalizer. Every emission is a `Candidate{bytes, producer-id, model-hash, prompt-closure-hash, sampler-params}` journaled with **zero authority**.
- **Kernel Plane K (trusted, pure):** a small Lean 4 kernel — pure total functions only; IO/clock/RNG are absent from the derivation context *by the type system*, so nondeterminism in the trusted path is a build error. All trusted decisions are functions of the **committed closure** (corpus roots, rulebase, profile, plan, budgets, logical clock).
- **The verify-out gate:** one total, pure, decidable predicate `K(state, transition, certificate)` at one physical single-writer serialization point. Acceptance ⇒ certificate-carrying, `seq' = seq+1` monotonic transition; **every** other outcome — including an error inside the gate's own predicates — is a recorded signed refusal with zero state change. Pre-action independent receipts are written by the gate *before* any effect executes; the acting model cannot touch the trail.

## 2. Admission (corpus and rulebase are different doors)
- **Source bytes (DIM-02):** enforced typed admission acts only; selection strictly by exact committed identifier + Merkle inclusion; similarity retrieval lives wholly in P and re-enters only as a candidate identifier that the gate resolves against the admitted set (corpus-size-independent grounding by construction). Corpus log is append-only, hash-chained, **version-indexed**: every source unit carries `(unit-id, version-interval, span digests)`.
- **Formal rules (DIM-16):** LLM autoformalization is strictly a candidate; admission requires a **signed human-authority record** binding rule ↔ NL pinpoint span, plus the **standing round-trip verbalization invariant**: the admitted rulebase carries a committed verbalization, machine-checked for drift on every rulebase change; drift blocks admission fail-closed. This is the class's honest answer to the interpretive gap: the NL→formal step is never machine-trusted; it is human-signed and machine-*falsified* (see exceed claim on AX-01's negative clause).

## 3. Reasoning substrate — the dominance-conjecture play
The rulebase is **structured defeasible rules with typed exceptions and a committed priority order, whose atoms range over decidable theories** (linear integer arithmetic, dates/deadlines/intervals) — the workloads the v1 conjecture ignored and that K-NSV natively owns via SMT.

Acceptance semantics: **sceptical acceptance under preferred semantics (with the ideal-semantics fast path), computed by certified reduction to the classical solver** — the in-class move that tests the AX-01 dominance conjecture head-on:
1. A **fixed, deterministic, verified encoder** compiles the committed rulebase + query into (a) grounding of theory atoms via proof-producing SMT (cvc5/Alethe, checked by the Carcara checker) and (b) an argumentation-framework SAT encoding (Besnard–Doutré/ASPARTIX lineage).
2. Preferred extensions are **exhaustively enumerated** by SAT with blocking clauses; each "no further extension" step and each maximality (preferredness) check emits an **LRAT proof checked by cake_lpr** — a CakeML end-to-end *verified* checker binary that exists and runs today.
3. The answer certificate = extension set + per-extension maximality refutations + final exhaustiveness refutation + the encoder's input/output digests. Per-query unique, deterministic, decidable on the finite base (H5/H3); **absence-of-defeater is itself certified** (the labelling plus refutations); anything unformalizable, contested, or over budget is **typed UNKNOWN — no proof, no answer**.
4. The encoder-soundness theorem (encoding correct w.r.t. the argumentation semantics) is a finite combinatorial statement targeted at Lean 4; it is the one load-bearing spec-only proof (§12).

Because the *substrate* remains the classical monotonic solver and defeasibility is admitted **data** compiled through a verified transform, this stays inside the DIM-01 family — and if it stands, the AX-01 dominance conjecture is falsified: the classical substrate reaches R5 while *also* covering theory atoms that pure AF calculi lack.

## 4. Pipeline (all model text flows left, all authority flows right)
NL query → (P) formalization candidates → (K) parse/type/admission against committed grammar and rulebase signature → (P) **lemma-DAG plan** → (K) the plan is admitted as a **Lean proof skeleton**: goal = target theorem; nodes = typed lemma obligations; edges = proof-term composition. Goal entailment, gap-freedom, and step soundness are literally kernel-checked; a `sorry` is a typed UNKNOWN obligation, and a defective plan **cannot come into existence** (fail-closed macroexpansion) → (P) budgeted test-time proof search per obligation (AlphaProof pattern: untrusted search, trusted checking) → (K) certificate assembly → (P) verbalization → (K) **round-trip drift check**: the verbalized answer is re-parsed and checked equivalent to the proof object; divergence blocks serving. The served explanation **is** the proof object (or its checked-equivalent verbalization) — divergence between explanation and decision is structurally impossible.

## 5. Certificates — assumption-tiered (the trust-boundary architecture)
Every certificate declares its tier: **T0** Lean-kernel-checked; **T1** checked by a *verified* external checker (cake_lpr LRAT, Carcara-checked Alethe); **T2** solver-attested only. T2 never serves as PASS — it is lifted to T0/T1 or decays to typed UNKNOWN. **Per-claim mechanical binding** (Proof-Carrying Numbers generalized): every atom in a served answer is bound to `(rule-id, source span digest, version-interval, t_legal)`; every citation carries the offline-recheckable tuple (proposition, pinpoint span, authority status at stated legal time via the version index and admitted treatment-graph data). Citation-like strings outside the committed grammar are typed UNKNOWN-CITATION, never upgraded.

## 6. State, time, memory
- **Matter state:** canonical typed record, single seat, writes only through the gate as all-or-nothing journaled transitions; reads deterministic. Reflective records (the system's own performance/evaluation data used by the improvement loop) are typed transitions through the *same* gate — memory about the self is as gated as memory about the world.
- **Bitemporality:** every answer is stamped `(t_legal = version key, t_knowledge = corpus Merkle root at derivation)` and is a pure function of that pair; any prior root is a valid historical t_knowledge; replay at the pair is exact. Cross-claim anachronism (mixed t_legal within one derivation without a typed cross-time rule) is rejected fail-closed.
- **Integrity witnessing is internal-consistency-only by class signature:** append-only chain, checkpoint-relative fork detection — the honest fork-consistency floor, declared, not hidden.

## 7. Orchestration, durability, liveness
Durable execution journal: every step journaled before execution; idempotency-keyed retries; compensations and intent/outcome journaling for external effects, with the irrevocable external act structurally outside the atomic section (matching the AX-11 ABSOLUTE clause). Commit = WAL + fsync barriers + atomic rename + read-back recompute (a transition counts committed only after recompute-and-compare of persisted bytes). Every trusted loop carries a well-founded variant; every solver/proposer call carries a **deterministic budget in abstract inference units** (conflicts, node expansions — never wall clock, preserving replay); terminal type = {SUCCESS+cert, typed FAIL, typed UNKNOWN/REFUSED} with no hang inhabitant; Lean's termination checker makes kernel non-termination a build error.

## 8. Cost and throughput
The kernel meters every run in exact abstract units recomputable to bit-equality; committed per-workload-class budgets are a **fail-closed envelope** — breach is a typed refusal, never silent degradation. Declared complexity classes: certificate *checking* is linear in certificate size; *search* is budget-capped B(class). Throughput: proposers embarrassingly parallel in P; verification is deterministic parallel-map with ordered serial fold through the gate; commits batch-amortized; overload is typed backpressure.

## 9. Falsification
Adversarial proposers (cross model families) generate attacks, mutations, and countermodels; **a refutation counts only when kernel-checked** (Lean/SMT/SAT-certified counterexample) — no LLM adjudicates an LLM. Independence is *machine-checkable*: the committed prompt-closure hash of a critic run proves its context excluded implementer rationale, and its producer-id proves a distinct model family. Findings live in a typed ledger; an unresolved finding blocks release admission fail-closed; escalation is a typed obligation to the accountable human authority.

## 10. Evolution
Verifier-gated improvement: any change — including a proposer-model swap — installs only after the gate recomputes the committed capability-floor vector from the prior release's chained census, proves pointwise non-regression, and re-checks all preservation proofs; statistical learning is confined to P and cannot alter K.

## 11. Generality
The kernel is a single Lean functor over a hash-committed `LegalOrderProfile` (citation grammar, calendar, deontic lexicon, publisher identities, article ranges). Because the kernel is pure, the *only* channel by which jurisdiction facts reach a trusted decision is the profile parameter — noninterference by construction, stated and proved as a kernel lemma. Generality is calculus-relative (single-calculus-multi-order): an order the calculus cannot express yields typed UNKNOWN, never a guess.

The per-dimension join (K-SUP) presumes axis attainments are modular — that the mechanism behind each class's best rung can be lifted out and recombined by max(). For K-NSV's profile that presumption fails in three concrete, checkable ways, and the failure is not fixable by adding components.

(1) AX-01 x AX-21 coupling — the certificate-format bottleneck. K-NSV reaches AX-21 R5 precisely BECAUSE its entire defeasible semantics is compiled to clausal/SMT certificates for which VERIFIED checkers exist today (cake_lpr for LRAT, Carcara for Alethe, the small Lean kernel). An envelope that instead imports K-ARG's native argumentation calculus or K-CAT's verified statutory calculus for AX-01 must transport THOSE proof objects to the executable at the same assurance — and no verified checker for native ASPIC labellings or bespoke-calculus certificates exists; building one is exactly re-deriving K-NSV's certified-reduction core. So on the AX-01/AX-21 pair the join faces a fork: keep the foreign native calculus and lose AX-21 R5 transport (the ceiling's weakest-link clause bites), or adopt the reduction and collapse into K-NSV on those legs. The maxima do not commute; the envelope is a profile, not a design.

(2) Operating-model incoherence — the AX-16/AX-17 proofs are model-relative. K-NSV's certified-accountable-stall and certified cost envelope are theorems on the declared single-node, single-writer, deterministic-budget operating model: one metering semantics through one gate. The envelope, to beat K-NSV's DIM-09 internal-consistency-only floor, must import K-TLOG's witness quorum or K-BFT's replicated write path — which changes the operating model (external parties that may fail forever now sit inside checkpoint/commit paths). Every liveness, stall-accountability, and worst-case-envelope certificate must then be re-proven on the new model, and some strictly weaken (bounded termination now conditions on quorum liveness; the deterministic cost meter no longer bounds commit latency). Per-axis max() silently assumes the proofs survive composition; composition invalidates them. A join that re-proves everything on one coherent model is a new architecture whose obligations nobody has discharged — under the tournament's own rules it enters as a fresh challenger carrying WOULD_NEED_BUILD everywhere, not as a frozen envelope that dominates by construction.

(3) The single-gate identity — one mechanism IS six axes. In K-NSV the verify-out gate is simultaneously the AX-03 serialization point, the AX-12 authority evaluator, the AX-06 receipt writer, the AX-09 UNKNOWN factory, the AX-11 commit point, and the AX-19 explanation source; several R5 rungs hold BECAUSE these are the same event inside the same all-or-nothing transition (AX-19's divergence-impossibility and AX-06's pre-action receipts both depend on effect-execution and trace-emission being one atomic act at one seat). A join that sources these axes from different classes necessarily splits that event across multiple seats and re-introduces exactly the gap classes (untraced effect, unarbitrated write, explanation/decision divergence) whose STRUCTURAL impossibility justified the R5 claims — degrading them to enforced-by-checking at best, which is a lower rung on AX-12/AX-19's own ladders. Hence any successful synthesis candidate must contain the single verify-out gate plus the certified-reduction core as a subobject: K-NSV is a retract of every coherent envelope. The envelope cannot strictly dominate the class on mechanism-entailed rungs — it can only re-host it, and a re-hosting is a K-NSV win recorded under another name.

# LEX-SATURA — the strongest Deterministic Monotonic Rule Engine (K-RULES steelman)

**Thesis.** The classical monotone rule engine, built at its historical strongest, is the only class whose every guarantee is a *theorem of the artifact's shape* rather than a promise of its process. Its power comes from one deliberate poverty: the trusted substrate is stratified typed Datalog — a language in which nondeterminism, non-termination, IO, and unbounded search are *inexpressible*. Everything below is commodity, buildable today from named parts.

## 1. Trusted substrate (DIM-01: monotonic-classical-solver)
- **Language:** typed Datalog with stratified negation and stratified ground aggregation (dates, sums, counts as evaluable ground terms). Safety and range-restriction checked at admission. Data complexity is polynomial — a classical theorem, not a benchmark.
- **Defeasibility, classically compiled:** exceptions, priorities, and defeaters are **reified typed data** (exception predicates, an acyclic superiority relation). A deterministic, spec-proven compiler (the Nute/Sergot lineage: exception-completion over an acyclic priority graph) turns them into stratified clauses. A rule fires only if its compiled exception literal *fails over the saturated fixpoint* — i.e., every potential defeater is definitively discharged by exhaustive closed-world search over the admitted base, or the conclusion is blocked. This is the mechanical content of defeater-sensitivity, delivered by a monotone solver over the frozen completed theory.
- **Stratification as admission law:** any rulebase whose conflict structure is non-stratifiable (cyclic attack through negation/priority) is **refused at admission** with typed `UNKNOWN/U2-conflict-structure`, escalated to the human codifier (DIM-16). On the admitted domain, grounded, ideal, preferred, and stable semantics *provably coincide* — the class buys totality by refusing, honestly and fail-closed, exactly the inputs where semantics diverge.
- Optional module: proof-producing decidable-theory checks (cvc5/Alethe, checked by carcara) under the same budget gates; the polynomial envelope claim is scoped to the core workload class.

## 2. Admission kernel (DIM-02/05/16; H4)
One total, decidable admission predicate at one physical single-writer serialization point. Admits typed source records (authority metadata, validity intervals), facts, and human-codified rules, each carrying a structured provenance record and the codifier's attribution. Checks: schema typing, safety, whole-base stratifiability, priority-graph acyclicity, temporal well-formedness, citation existence/resolution against the admitted authority registry. Every refusal is a typed, recorded event. No LLM anywhere (H1) — codification is human-authoritative.

## 3. Evaluation and answers (H2/H3/H5)
Semi-naive bottom-up **saturation to fixpoint** per stratum under a fixed total rule-application order. Recorded per derived atom: the **derivation forest** (rules + leaf facts). Every query at a declared legal time *t* (validity-interval guards compiled into rule bodies) returns exactly one of:
