# K-TLOG/Ω — "THE WITNESSED WATCHTOWER": a Witnessed Legal Transparency Institution

## 0. Trust thesis (why this class exists)
Every other admissible class ends its verification story at a producer-signed head: the verifier must either trust that head (H8 violation) or hold a prior checkpoint (fork-consistency floor). The v2 ceilings for AX-07(c), AX-08(b) and AX-12 all name the SAME carve-out: the fork-consistency cap is RESOURCE_BOUNDED on the declared witness set, and witness networks are enrollable today. K-TLOG/Ω is the class that spends that resource. Its organizing principle: **one canonical witnessed log is the institution** — every trusted act (capture, admission, formalization, derivation, answer, governance change, evolution step, refusal) becomes real only by becoming a leaf under a checkpoint that independent third parties have consistency-verified and timestamp-cosigned. Everything else is a pure function of that log.

## 1. The Spine — canonical witnessed append-only log
- **Structure**: one RFC 6962/9162-style Merkle tree over domain-separated, typed leaves; leaf body = `H(salt || canonical-CBOR(body))` (salted per-leaf commitments → lawful-erasure compatible, per the AX-07 v2 lattice refinement). Checkpoints in C2SP signed-note format; strict `seq' = seq + 1` (H4/H6: single canonical serialization point, gapless monotone history).
- **Single writer**: one physical Sequencer process behind one kernel admission predicate `K(state, transition, certificate)` (AX-12 ceiling shape). Every non-acceptance outcome — including internal gate errors — is a **signed, logged refusal leaf with zero state change** (fail-closed totality, H3).
- **Witness quorum (DIM-09)**: k-of-n independent witnesses (C2SP tlog-witness protocol) each verify an append-only **consistency proof** from their last-cosigned checkpoint before cosigning with a timestamp. Committed **client-side nested k-of-n trust policy** (C2SP tlog-policy) as data in the log itself. Witness roster mixes organizational witnesses (transparency.dev omniwitness network — operational today), hardware-rooted witnesses (Armored Witness / TKey — shipping hardware), and named institutional witnesses (bar association, national archive, court IT service — the legal-order-native enrollment this class uniquely motivates).
- **External time (DIM-04)**: every checkpoint additionally carries (i) an eIDAS-qualified RFC 3161 timestamp (statutory burden-shifting presumption in EU legal orders), (ii) Roughtime malfeasance-provable timestamps, (iii) the witnesses' own cosignature timestamps — giving every act a k-of-n external-time bracket at ≤1-minute granularity with **zero producer trust** (exactly the AX-17 clause-(c) ceiling mechanism).
- **Static tiled read path**: the entire log is served as immutable tiles (C2SP tlog-tiles; the Static-CT / Sunlight / Tessera / Rekor-v2 pattern, all running in production today) from dumb storage and arbitrary mirrors/CDNs. The read path holds no keys and makes no decisions; monitors replay everything from tiles alone.
- **Receipts**: every admitted act yields a portable countersigned receipt (SCITT-pattern / CCF COSE receipt profile): inclusion proof + checkpoint + witness cosignatures + external timestamps. **A receipt is a self-contained evidentiary object** verifiable offline against pinned third-party keys — the institution's deliverable to courts, regulators, and counterparties.
- **Forensic attribution**: two signed checkpoints for the same seq = producer-attributable fork evidence; a witness cosigning inconsistent heads = witness-attributable evidence; ≥t+1 culprit identification and accountable liveness (missing cosignatures name the absent witnesses).

## 2. Serving gate (fail-closed by construction)
An answer is servable **iff** its full receipt validates under the committed trust policy against a sufficiently fresh witnessed checkpoint. Stale quorum, missing cosignature, failed inclusion, unfresh time bracket → typed refusal naming the cause (H3). This makes "serve an unwitnessed conclusion" structurally impossible, not forbidden — the serving path has no code path that emits an answer without a receipt.

## 3. Verifiable authority directory (DIM-07 extension)
A key-transparency-style structure (log tree + prefix tree; the KEYTRANS/Signal-AKD/Parakeet pattern, deployed at scale today) maps role → key → class-of-act, with **named external auditors** and split-view gossip. Every signature on any leaf is validated against the directory state at the receipt's genTime; directory mutations are themselves witnessed log leaves. Genesis trust anchor committed once, offline-recomputable delegation chains (AX-12 ceiling: signatures transfer trust, the genesis anchor is irreducible and declared).

## 4. Capture & grounding front-end (DIM-02, AX-04)
Dual-digest attested capture: `(H(captured-bytes), H(E(captured-bytes)))` with deterministic third-party re-executable extractor E. Origin tiers, each a typed admission level: (a) publisher signature verified where official publishers sign; (b) TLS-channel attestation (DECO/TLSNotary-class or TEE-attested fetcher) where unsigned; (c) k-of-n independent capture witnesses each committing the digest into their own witnessed logs (corroboration with no absolute maximum, per the AX-04 ceiling); below these → typed UNKNOWN/provisional, never silently admitted. # QUORUM CUSTODIAN — maximal K-BFT instance (Replicated Deterministic Legal Ledger)

## 0. Thesis
The A4/CFLLD post-mortem proved that an institution that does not hold the bytes cannot replay, cannot detect its own blind spots, and dies with its sources. The single-writer answer ("hold the bytes once, let witnesses watch the custodian") converts that lesson into a new single point of institutional failure: one organization's key, one organization's ops team, one organization's continued existence. K-BFT completes the lesson: **the institution IS a quorum of mutually distrusting custodians, each holding all the bytes, and canonical truth is whatever the one machine-checked-nonforking replicated total order admits.** Every trusted decision is independently recomputed by every operator before it exists; equivocation is prevented by quorum intersection, not detected after the fact.

## 1. Topology and trust model
- Validator set: n = 3f+1 replicas, recommended n = 7 (f = 2), minimum n = 4 (f = 1), operated by institutionally independent categories (e.g., bar association, court administration, national printing office/gazette authority, a university law+CS faculty, a notarial chamber, an archival institution, the creator's organization holding exactly ONE seat). Heterogeneous/asymmetric quorum declarations (FBA/Satrapy-class) are admissible at the membership layer and are themselves committed data.
- Threat model, declared: safety (nonforking, admission integrity) holds against ≤ f Byzantine operators; liveness holds under partial synchrony with ≤ f faulty. **Declared degradation above threshold (honest):** if ≥ f+1 collude, forks become possible — but every committed entry carries a quorum certificate, so any safety violation yields cryptographic, producer-attributable evidence identifying ≥ f+1 signers of conflicting entries (accountable-safety / BFT-forensics results). Above threshold K-BFT degrades exactly to the witness-class evidence regime (attributable fork proofs), never below it. Below threshold it is strictly above it.
- Genesis: validator identities, quorum rule, initial code identity, and the creator's governance key are the hash-committed genesis trust anchor (irreducible per the AX-12 ceiling — signatures transfer trust, they cannot create it). Genesis is published widely and externally timestamped.

## 2. Consensus substrate (DIM-05 bft-replicated-total-order, DIM-09 full-bft-replication)
- One machine-checked-nonforking replicated total order realizing ONE LOGICAL WRITER (the frozen H4/AX-03 wording names this realization explicitly). Concrete, buildable today, two admissible instantiations:
  (a) CometBFT/Tendermint-class: production-grade, TLA+ safety spec model-checked (Apalache), deterministic ABCI state-machine interface; or Mysticeti-class DAG-BFT (production in Sui) for sub-second finality.
  (b) Verified-substrate option: Velisarios-class (Coq-verified PBFT with extracted executable) or the ACL2-verified nonforking DAG-consensus line — machine-checked agreement/nonforking proofs replayable offline today.
- Order-then-execute (Calvin-class): consensus orders opaque transaction bytes; the deterministic execution layer evaluates admission at the committed position. This is deterministic conflict-ordered execution per the v2 AX-03 ceiling — non-commuting effects execute under a pre-committed serialization order.
- External time: every block header is countersigned by k-of-n external time authorities (Roughtime-class + eIDAS-qualified TSA), giving offline-verifiable wall-clock brackets per the AX-17 ceiling clause (c).

## 3. The admission kernel at consensus commit (H4, fail-closed totality)
- One total, pure, decidable predicate K(state, tx, cert) IS the replicated state machine's transition function. A transition becomes canonical iff 2f+1 replicas deterministically compute K = ACCEPT at its committed sequence position — admission strictly BEFORE canonicalization, at the single logical serialization point.
- Every non-acceptance — including an error raised inside K's own predicates — is itself a committed, quorum-certified REFUSAL entry with zero state change (fail-closed totality per the AX-12 ceiling). K's evaluation is wrapped in a total exception boundary whose only non-ACCEPT outcome constructor is the typed refusal.
- **Omission accountability (unique to this class):** a submitter sends the transaction to f+1 validators; inclusion rules (leader rotation / DAG inclusion) guarantee eventual ordering under liveness assumptions, so the institution cannot silently drop a request — a single writer can (no record, no refusal, nothing to audit).

## 4. Trusted legal core (DIM-01, replicated)
- Reasoning substrate: grounded-defeasible-certified labeller (alternating-fixpoint well-founded labelling with offline-recheckable derivation trees) + grounded-defeasible-over-decidable-theories (dates/deadlines/arithmetic via solver-discharged defeater search), with the certified ideal/sceptical-preferred rung (certified exhaustive-extension enumeration, refutation-complete search traces, e.g. proof-logging SAT/ASP enumeration) available under a declared, committed AX-17 cost budget for even-cycle norm conflicts. [The certified-enumeration certifier is spec-only today — flagged WOULD_NEED_BUILD.]
- **Query-as-transaction:** a legal query (q, t_legal, t_knowledge, budget) is itself an admitted transaction; its answer — PASS+certificate / FAIL+counter-certificate / KNOWN-with-stability-certificate / typed UNKNOWN with closed-enumeration cause — is computed independently by every replica as a pure function of committed state and becomes a committed ledger entry. **An answer is served only with f+1 matching signatures over the certificate hash: every emitted legal conclusion is independently recomputed by f+1 institutionally independent operators BEFORE it exists as an output.** This is standing n-version verification at serve time, on top of (not instead of) offline re-checkability.
- H1: no statistical model exists anywhere in the state machine. LLM output (candidate formalizations, candidate citations, retrieval suggestions) enters only as untrusted candidate transactions that must pass K, carrying attested human-authority admission records (DIM-16 below).

## 5. Byte custody (DIM-02 — the CFLLD lesson, completed)
- attested-capture-dual-digest: gazette/court bytes enter via an admission transaction carrying (i) publisher signature (PAdES/CMS) where it exists, or (ii) a k-of-n independent capture-witness attestation set, or (iii) an attested-channel capture receipt; anything weaker admits only as typed UNKNOWN/provisional. Deterministic extraction E committed as a dual digest with byte-equality replay.
- **Replicated custody:** every validator holds the full content-addressed corpus; the Merkle state root in every quorum-certified block commits corpus membership. Source withdrawal or silent mutation (the exact CFLLD killer) cannot orphan a single past answer, and corpus survival no longer depends on any one organization's storage. Selection is by exact committed identifier only; Merkle inclusion proofs give O(log n) membership against the quorum-certified root.

## 6. Bitemporal state (DIM-04)
- **t_knowledge ≡ commit height.** Consensus gives the institution a non-equivocable, totally ordered definition of "what was known when" — knowledge time is not a producer-asserted timestamp but a quorum-certified sequence position, externally time-bracketed per §2. t_legal comes from typed amendment events (repeal/substitution/insertion event calculus) under total-bitemporal-view: one pure function View(t_legal, h) over Merkle-committed snapshots, typed UNKNOWN off committed coverage.

## 7. Provenance, receipts, light clients (DIM-08)
- per-step-recompute-DAG: every transformation committed as (input-hash, deterministic-op-id, output-hash) under domain-separated Merkle roots bound into the block identity.
- proof-carrying-state-updates (the class signature's DIM-08 pick): each delta carries a succinct update-validity proof over bounded structures (PC-CRDT-class), so light clients validate deltas in O(1) without replay — declared honestly as bounded-structure proofs, NOT whole-pipeline arithmetization.
- Portable receipts: (quorum certificate over block header) + (Merkle inclusion proof) + (answer certificate) = a self-contained, offline-checkable receipt against pinned genesis; witnesses/auditors are subsumed as non-voting learner replicas whose countersignatures derive from, never run parallel to, the commit certificates — one trust algebra, no second adjudication layer.

## 8. Memory, erasure, reflection (DIM-07)
- Canonical typed matter state is the replicated state machine's state; every write is an all-or-nothing quorum-certified transition (H6 by construction). Reflective episodes (the system's record of its own performance, falsification runs, stalls) are themselves admitted transactions.
- Lawful erasure: hash chain over salted per-leaf commitments H(salt‖body); an erasure is an admitted, quorum-certified erasure-certificate transaction upon which every replica crypto-shreds the salt/body — chain verification and inclusion proofs survive; silent deletion is structurally impossible.

## 9. Governance, evolution, formalization admission (DIM-16, AX-12, AX-20)
- DIM-16: human-authoritative-codification + n-version-formalization-admission. A rulebase change transaction carries (i) the signed human-authority record binding each rule to its NL source span, (ii) the SAT-diff certificate over independently produced formalizations (behavioral disagreement = typed ambiguity object that BLOCKS admission), (iii) the round-trip-verbalization drift check. K verifies all three at consensus commit. Machine authority extends to process compliance only; substantive rightness remains with the accountable human creator, whose approval signature is a required conjunct of K for governance-class transactions.
- AX-20 ratchet INSIDE K: a code/rulebase upgrade transaction must carry the floor-vector recomputation and pointwise non-regression certificate plus preservation-proof re-checks; replicas verify before the upgrade activates at a declared future height, atomically, everywhere. **No single operator — including the creator's own ops team — can hot-patch the trusted path: code identity is consensus-governed state, and bypassing the ratchet requires f+1 collusion.** This makes H7 an intrusion-resistance property, not just a process property.

## 10. Determinism engineering (AX-14) and offline verification (H8, AX-13)
- The state machine is a pure function in a pinned, hash-committed toolchain (pure SBCL/OCaml/Rust subset; no wall-clock, RNG, IO, or map-iteration nondeterminism; logical clock = commit height). SMR gives a second, structural enforcement layer no single-writer design has: **any nondeterminism in the trusted path manifests as cross-replica state-root divergence, which is a consensus-visible, blocking, attributable fault — detected in production, not just in review.**
- Offline verifier: holds genesis + the committed validator-set history; verifies quorum-certificate chains, replays the deterministic state machine from genesis, recompute-and-compares every state root and answer certificate. Zero producer trust — and unlike the single-writer case, "producer" here is not one organization but any 2f+1 subset; the offline story is identical in kind, the live story strictly stronger. Fresh-verifier wholesale-replacement residue (a fabricated parallel ledger from a different genesis) remains, mitigated by wide genesis publication + external timestamping — declared, not denied.

## 11. Honest cost declaration (AX-17/AX-18)
- Commit latency class: consensus commit (WAN round-trips; ~0.5–1 s Mysticeti-class, 1–3 s CometBFT-class) — one latency class below single-node fsync. Declared per frozen workload class; deterministic execution yields EXACT abstract cost certificates (operations/bytes-hashed/stage-invocations) recomputable to bit-equality, per AX-17 ceiling clause (a); the fail-closed cost-budget gate is part of K. No worst-case wall-clock envelope exists under asynchrony (FLP) — a stall is a typed, validator-attributable state, never a silent hang.
- Throughput: consensus-class throughput (10³–10⁵ tx/s) exceeds any plausible legal-institution workload by orders of magnitude; the batched amortized serialization floor of the AX-18 ceiling applies per block. Scaling class declared, not yet verified from the architecture.

## 12. Buildability inventory
Exists today, off the shelf: CometBFT / Mysticeti (production consensus), CCF (replicated ledger + receipts), Velisarios / ACL2-verified consensus proofs, sparse Merkle state trees, quorum-cert light clients, Roughtime/eIDAS anchoring, salted-commitment erasure, DRAT/proof-logging SAT. Standard engineering: the deterministic ABCI-style legal state machine, admission kernel, grounded labeller (JTMS-class engines exist), bitemporal view, capture attestation. Spec-only (flagged in the profile): certified ideal-semantics enumeration certifier; the closed unknowability-cause census with stability certificates; formal verification of the authority model; verified recovery/state-sync procedure; per-step preservation proofs for the evolution ratchet; verified spec-to-source transport for the whole assembled system.

## 13. H1–H8 mapping (one line each)
H1: no model in the state machine — candidates enter only through K with attested human admission. H2: typed UNKNOWN is a first-class kernel output with closed cause enumeration. H3: fail-closed totality — refusal entries, divergence halts, budget gates. H4: admission at consensus commit = the single decidable admission predicate BEFORE canonicalization at one machine-checked-nonforking logical serialization point (the frozen wording, verbatim). H5: deterministic replay is the definitional requirement of SMR. H6: quorum-certified block commit is all-or-nothing and accountable. H7: the ratchet is a conjunct of K, collusion-resistant. H8: full offline replay from genesis with zero producer trust.
